description: This file defines the 'Duration' class in the org.openmrs package, representing time durations with SNOMED CT codes and methods for manipulating Date objects based on different units of time.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration with a specific SNOMED CT code and provides methods to add this duration to Date objects.

methods.name: addToDate
methods.description: Adds the duration to a given start date, considering the unit of duration and optionally a recurrence frequency.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the SNOMED CT concept code from a provided Concept object if it matches certain SNOMED CT criteria.
